fields.description: Lunara is The Strand’s first residential release: three connected buildings with balconies and terraces, shared recreation spaces and ground-level activity in the Urban District.

sources.label: RAK Properties · Lunara sales announcement, 27 February 2026

overview: Three connected buildings contain 583 homes, ranging from compact one-bedroom layouts to a single three-bedroom penthouse.
research.locationNote: The Strand’s Urban District is in the mainland Marjan Beach District, Ras Al Khaimah. The portal’s Al Marjan Island grouping does not establish an island address.
research.priceNote: The current factsheet and official microsite advertise AED 1.05m for the one-bedroom Suite. The 27 February 2026 announcement quoted AED 1.28m at launch. These are published starting guides, not a live unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The developer advertises 40/60 without an instalment calendar. The table uses Property Finder’s separately attributed 10/30/60 reference; confirm the applicable booking and construction terms.
research.handoverNote: The current factsheet forecasts Q4 2029; the 27 February 2026 release forecast Q1 2029. The main project page still says TBC. Obtain the contracted completion date.
unresolved: Factsheet Deluxe areas differ from detailed plans. Published totals also contain component-sum discrepancies; values below retain the printed totals.
The penthouse repeats 2,852.22 ft² on both levels; confirm its whole-home area rather than adding them.
Original dated payment milestones, ownership instrument, service charges and present availability were not verified.
